theme-presets.picker.all.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch that lists every preset. A count follows the word.

theme-presets.picker.clear-search.note: Text button shown when no preset matches; empties the search box and shows all presets.

theme-presets.picker.contacts-another-we.note: Small privacy tag on a preset card: this preset loads a font or image from an external site.

theme-presets.picker.delete.note: Button on a saved preset in My presets; removes the preset after confirmation.

theme-presets.picker.desert.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.export.note: Button on a saved preset; downloads it as a file so it can be shared or imported elsewhere.

theme-presets.picker.fantasy.note: Suggested search word, lower case, on a button after a failed search; also a hidden keyword for fantasy presets. Not the heading, which is 'Fantasy'.

theme-presets.picker.fantasy-2.note: Sub-heading above the fantasy presets in the Sci-fi & fantasy group. The lower-case 'fantasy' key is a search word instead.

theme-presets.picker.forest.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.genre.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the Sci-fi & fantasy presets.

theme-presets.picker.independent-colour-.text: Independent colour schemes made for Magic Card. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any film, series, book or game.
theme-presets.picker.independent-colour-.note: Legal-style disclaimer above the Sci-fi & fantasy presets. Keep the meaning exactly; Magic Card is the product name and stays untranslated.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch for presets that take after a known colour scheme. A count follows. Capitalised; the lower-case key is a hidden search word.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by-2.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the presets in the 'Inspired by' group.

theme-presets.picker.inspired-by-name.note: Caption on a preset card. {name} is the name of the real colour scheme it takes after, such as Nord; keep it unchanged.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

theme-presets.picker.my.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the user's own saved presets. Use the word a user would type for 'my'.

theme-presets.picker.my-presets.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch and group heading for presets the user saved. A count follows.

theme-presets.picker.n-shown.text: {n, plural, one {# preset} other {# presets}} shown
theme-presets.picker.n-shown.note: Screen-reader status after filtering the preset list. {n} is the number of presets now visible.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

theme-presets.picker.n-shown-try-a-b-c-d.text: {n, plural, one {# preset} other {# presets}} shown. Try {a}, {b}, {c}, {d} or {e}.
theme-presets.picker.n-shown-try-a-b-c-d.note: Screen-reader status when a search finds nothing. {n} is the number shown (0 here). {a} to {e} are five suggested search words, the translations of sci-fi, fantasy, neon, desert and forest.

vars.a: The value that replaces a in the text.
vars.b: The value that replaces b in the text.
vars.c: The value that replaces c in the text.
vars.d: The value that replaces d in the text.
vars.e: The value that replaces e in the text.
vars.n: The count the text is about.

theme-presets.picker.name-palette-or-sty.note: Placeholder text in the preset search box. 'Palette' means colour palette.

theme-presets.picker.neon.note: Suggested search word, lower case, shown on a button after a failed search. Clicking it searches for this word.

theme-presets.picker.no-preset-matches-q.note: Empty search result. {query} is the text typed in the preset search box; do not translate it.

vars.query: The value that replaces query in the text.

theme-presets.picker.original.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch for presets made for Magic Card, not based on another scheme. A count follows. Not 'initial'.

theme-presets.picker.original-2.note: Hidden search keyword, lower case, not shown. Typing it finds the presets in the 'Original' group.

theme-presets.picker.preset.note: Accessible name (not visible) of the radio group that lists presets. A preset is a ready-made set of theme colours.

theme-presets.picker.presets-use-genre-a.text: Presets use genre and colour words, not titles. Try one of these:
theme-presets.picker.presets-use-genre-a.note: Help text above the suggestion buttons, which are the words sci-fi, fantasy, neon, desert and forest. Ends with a colon.

theme-presets.picker.rename.note: Button on a saved preset in My presets; lets the user change the preset's name.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi.note: Suggested search word, lower case, on a button after a failed search; also a hidden keyword for sci-fi presets. Not the heading, which is 'Sci-fi'.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi-2.note: Sub-heading above the sci-fi presets in the Sci-fi & fantasy group. The lower-case 'sci-fi' key is a search word instead.

theme-presets.picker.sci-fi-fantasy.note: Option in the 'Show' filter switch and group heading for genre-themed presets. A count follows.

theme-presets.picker.search-presets.note: Accessible name (not visible) of the preset search box.

theme-presets.picker.show.note: Label of the filter switch (All, Original, Inspired by, ...). It is a verb: 'Show: All'.
